title: When the Interior Sings
author: L. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Yara Ashgrove, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
